mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signal accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% (UNRATE > 7.5%) indicates labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through recession fears.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) from prior month signal broad demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as recession risks escalate.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) trigger Federal Reserve tightening, increasing real rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production expansion (INDPRO > 100) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO > 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 850 thousand units (HOUST < 850) signal housing market weakness that precedes broader economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST < 850, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent payroll declines (PAYEMS < prior month) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > prior month) indicate severe labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.0%) prompt accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days through lower real rates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.
